text_block_list.text:
...Impressive, what a massive haul.
I wouldn't have been able to pull this off.
choice_data_list: If you don't mind, please give that to Crown.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I'll gladly take you up on that.
Naturally, I'll let them know it's from you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, that's an incredible amount.
If I went home carrying this many plushies..."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
Crown might be surprised as well.
